about.label: About Us
about.title: Experience that turns projects into results
about.intro: Intensebinary is an electrical engineering and consulting firm based in Portugal. Our team of seasoned professionals has been in the industry since 1986, delivering exceptional services to clients in both the public and private sectors.
about.history: While our expertise spans over 35 years, the company was formally established in 2019 — combining technical tradition with modern solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients.
about.specialization: We specialize in electrical engineering projects: design, installation and maintenance of electrical systems for buildings, infrastructures and industrial facilities. Every solution is tailor-made, with a focus on quality and professionalism.
about.consulting: Beyond engineering, we offer customized business and market consulting — strategic insights and practical solutions that help companies grow in their industries.

mission.label: Mission, Vision & Values
mission.missionText: To provide exceptional quality engineering and consulting services tailored to our clients' specific needs, with loyalty, integrity and ethical principles — fair prices and a direct, professional approach.
mission.visionText: To be a regional reference in technical consulting and engineering, with a highly qualified team committed to the company's values — the preferred choice for lighting solutions and developments for local public entities and business owners.
